correctness.rationale: A rigorous event-sweep with enter-before-exit tie handling bounds the full closed-interval patterns by 2m. Each marked vertex can contribute at most one self-deleted open trace, yielding min(2^m,3m). Spacing-3/4 marked centers and one unmarked witness per full-pattern cell give all 2m full patterns; for m≥4 each of the m marked vertices supplies an additional distinct noncontiguous or nonrealizable singleton trace. m=1,2,3 are explicitly classified. The VC-dimension corollaries follow from the sharp cardinalities. A standalone extracted Python verifier checked 1,066,494 grid cases and exact witnesses through m=40; finite checks corroborate the proof but are not its justification.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-parameter sharp invariant for a canonical dense hereditary class with unrestricted clique size. It resolves the exact one-point adjacency-type count (including the leading coefficient and all small exceptions), exhibits minimum-order saturating graphs, and rigorously separates open/closed shattering dimensions despite identical VC-density exponent.
